summary_md: **Yance Zhang ([@Yance16z](https://x.com/Yance16z/status/2115139934101344715))** shares **anatomy**, an agent skill that turns a concept into an interactive isometric illustration — a small machine you can hover over and take apart to see how it works.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - wheresryan22/anatomy: An agent skill for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems. Generates polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.

relevance: A skill for generating explorable explanatory visuals.
